title: Business Analyst
text: Business Analyst at Woods Bagot Pty Ltd (Sydney, CBD, Inner West & Eastern Suburbs; Full Time; salary: not stated). Woods Bagot is seeking a Business Analyst to join our global People and Culture team About you As the successful candidate you have an extensive analytical and problem solving background. You understand Business Processes and Procedures and have the ability to design, document and solve process related issues. You can speak ‘IT’ while having the ability to translate back to employees with a non-technical background. You have a track record in successfully implementing projects from start to finish. You will be able to demonstrate: Strong analytical and problem solving abilities Understanding of and ability to design future-state processes, considering stakeholder needs Proficient in writing specifications Excellent technical communication skills Advanced knowledge of MS Office, in particular Excel and Word. Good understanding of the Human Resource function and practices (Including payroll) HRIS Implementation experience, Successfactors would be a distinct advantage About the role This newly created role will report to the Global Leader, People & Culture, but will also work with individual People & Culture team members at a regional or studio level. The Business Analyst will act as the intermediary between end-users and IT to ensure that user requirements are delivered in the IT solution. Key Responsibilities: Documentation of configuration requirements for each functional area (Leave, Organisation Structure, Compensation etc.) Assist in providing solutions for global design including processes and configuration of the system Review opportunities for process improvement within and across functional environments Assist with system deployment, including change management and training Assist in the development and execution of test cases scenarios and test cases for Functional, System and UAT testing Assist in the Configuration and Setup of the system Lead Data Cleanse exercise ready for HRIS Implementation Ensure timely delivery of accurate reporting for People and Culture business needs. Provides statistical analysis of the Woods Bagot workforce to support existing and new People and Culture initiatives. Experience Required 5 years experience as a Business Analyst or similar Proven experience and track record in the successful implementation of IT projects Sound general IT experience (applications and/or infrastructure) including systemic knowledge of IT development, operational and change management processes and methodologies Proven experience in implementation of HRIS system (highly desirable) We are committed to developing Dynamic Careers. We believe that our people's potential is released through opportunities and experiences which are the reward for contribution, initiative, and personal accountability. To apply please send your resume and cover letter. WOODSBAGOT.COM
